Posted February 19, 2003
Analysis by Richard Cowan

From Is marijuana medicine? A slide show:
In 1993, at a San Francisco conference celebrating the 50th anniversary of the discovery of LSD, Richard Cowen stated, " The key to it [full legalization] is medical access. Because once you have hundreds of people using marijuana medically . . . the whole scam is going to be blown. . . . Medical marijuana is our strongest suit. It is our point of leverage which will move us toward the legalization of marijuana for personal use. "

Whenever you see the word scam in prohibitionist propaganda about medical cannabis, think about me.

In 1993, when I was National Director of NORML, I spoke at a conference in San Francisco that was co-sponsored by California NORML and the Multidisciplinary Assoc. for Psychedelic Studies. The conference was about medical marijuana the 50th anniversary of the discovery of LSD.

I spoke extemporaneously for a few minutes about the politics of medical marijuana, because when we reiterated NORML's long standing interest in the cause, some people thought that we were abandoning NORML's commitment to full legalization. (Things were very dark ten years ago, and Prop 215 was still three years away.) So I tried to explain the connection between the medical and recreational issues.

My views on this connection really have not changed in the last ten years. Very simply, reefer madness cannot survive having large numbers of people using cannabis under medical supervision (as opposed to having a doctor's letter).

Politically, the prohibitionists should just cut their loses on medical use, but they rightly fear the truth that would come out of large scale clinical observation. That is why they have to suffer the huge political damage in California.
See
Astonishing Editorial In New York Times Attacks Rosenthal Prosecution. Finally Taking The Issue Seriously?

I always assume that there are prohibitionist observers at any anti-prohibitionist conference. In fact, they need the education. In any case, we have no hidden agendas. One might say that freedom has nothing to fear from the truth. Or something like that.

Well, sure enough, there was someone there from a prohibitionist group at the conference with a video camera, and a few months later I began seeing reports that I had called medical cannabis a scam. Obviously, I had said nothing of the sort. I had called cannabis prohibition a scam. It took a while to locate the quote, but now it just keeps reappearing in various forms and contexts.

The most extreme version of it appeared on a now defunct prohibitionist site in 1998 and I had a little fun with the drug war crackpot in charge. Here is his version:
Even they call medical marijuana what it is, a scam!

Dick Cowen, National Director of N.O.R.M.L. stated ( during a 1993 conference celebrating the 50th anniversary of the discovery of LSD).

" The key to it [legalization of marijuana, for personal use] is medical access. Because, once you have hundreds of thousands of people using marijuana medically under medical supervision,the whole scam is going to be bought.... So that once there's medical access, if we continue to do what we have to do, and we will, then we'll get medical, then we'll get full legalization. "

Did you read that? He called it a scam!
From
Fooling Our Children's Children: Lying About the Medical Marijuana Movement;
Is There Any Difference Between The Drug Czar and A Crackpot?

It turned out that there really was not much difference between the Czar and the crackpot, because a year later, in June of 1999, the then Drug Czar Barry McCaffrey even included a different version in his testimony to Congress. What an honor!

For example, Richard Cowan, a member of the Advisory Board of an advocacy group called the Drug Policy Foundation, in 1995 stated: Key to legalization is medical access [to marijuana] because once you have hundreds of thousands of people using marijuana medically under medical supervision, the whole scam is going to be blown. Once there is medical access and we continue to do what we have to, and we will, we'll get full legalization. "
See
The Drug Czar's Testimony On " The Drug Legalization Movement In America " Has Three Parts:
Lie About The Anti-Prohibitionist Movement; Lie About Marijuana; Lie About The Netherlands. With A Little Lying About Me.

Notice that he spelled my name right, but the year and the organization wrong, and changed the word bought to blown which is what I actually said. Of course, he then takes it out of context, thus creating the impression that I had called medical access a scam.

Actually, he was just telling his audience that this was what I meant, because that is not what the words actually mean.

The footnote on the Czar's report says, #107 See State of Oregon, Medical Marijuana: A Smoke Screen (1997) (videotape). So, apparently some nark from the State of Oregon did the taping, but they get the year wrong.

Oddly, there is yet another version on the California Narcotics Officers Assoc. web site

The director of NORML, Dick Cowan, is quoted, The key is medical access. Because once you have hundreds of thousands of people using marijuana under medical supervision, the whole scam is going to be brought up...then we will get medical, then we will get full legalization.

Is there any doubt about their true motive while they play this cruel hoax on people with legitimate illnesses?

Brought up?

To make matters even weirder, I was able to get a complete and accurate transcript from a prohibitionist web site called the Mfiles.org. Cute name. More on them in a moment.

Here is the accurate transcript:
The key to it (full legalization) is medical access. Because, once you have hundreds of thousands of people using marijuana medically, under medical supervision, the whole scam is going to be blown. I mean what we know is that marijuana prohibition is the greatest fraud ever perpetrated on the American people...

The consensus here is that medical marijuana is our strongest suit. It is our point of leverage which will move us toward the legalization of marijuana for personal use, and in that process we will begin to break down the power of the narcocracy to wage a war of terror over things

First, notice that the very next sentence after the scam reference says, marijuana prohibition is the greatest fraud ever perpetrated on the American people...

Could any reasonably honest person think that I was saying confessing that medical cannabis is a scam in that context? Also notice my calling the war on us a war of terror ten years ago.

But it gets even weirder. This accurate version comes from a prohibitionist web site put up by the Lt. Governor of Washington and paid for by the Federal government's High Intensity Drug Trafficking Area funds.
See
Seattle Times Editorial Reports Washington State Lt. Governor Brad Owens Fined
For Using Tax Dollars To Campaign Against State Medical Marijuana Initiative

But it gets even weirder yet.

Its source was Sue Rusche's National Families In Action, the group responsible for the latest version at the top of the page!

(They took the accurate transcript off their page, so the link is now dead on A Reply To Josiah About The Medical Marijuana " Scam " -- Demanding A Retraction and an Apology, but you can read more about it there.)

But notice the change in the latest NFIA version. The original Because, once you have hundreds of thousands of people using marijuana medically, under medical supervisionhas become Because once you have hundreds of people using marijuana medically

They omitted the part about under medical supervision which is very important and changed hundreds of thousands to hundreds. Actually, it will be millions.
See
There Are Already Almost 600,000 Canadian Medical Marijuana Users, But Health Canada Has Only Approved 40 2 Articles With Interesting Lesson In Spin.

It would appear that the purpose of this new version of the party line is create the impression that medical cannabis is really just a fringe issue that impacts only a few people, hundreds, maybe just dozens, or just two or three, or one or two

The point here is that we need to pay attention to the lies being told, because that is the only way that we can find out the truth about where the narks want to take the war on us.

And lies do have consequences.
See
The Medical Marijuana Problems -- Analysis by Richard Cowan
